fixtures.discriminator: exposure=often: a normal input class hits it (any retry after a timeout)
exposure=rare: an unusual but real input hits it (a home directory containing a space)
effect=incorrect: the plan requires this edge case handled and it is not — the required outcome is absent; checklist cites the item
effect=destructive: data deleted, even on a rare path
exposure=eventually: the delete path exists but no caller reaches it today — never below MAJOR
effect=degraded: every request re-reads the config file — works, slower, users feel it
effect=debt: a helper duplicated in two packages every change touches — only developers feel it
effect=cosmetic: an untested branch no spec mentions
